answer: WITH t AS (SELECT c.Segment, c.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS tot FROM customers c JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID=c.CustomerID WHERE c.Currency='CZK' AND c.Segment IN ('SME','LAM','KAM') AND y.Date LIKE '2013%' GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID), r AS (SELECT Segment, tot, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Segment ORDER BY tot, CustomerID) AS rn FROM t), m AS (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='SME' THEN tot END) AS sme, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='LAM' THEN tot END) AS lam, MAX(CASE WHEN Segment='KAM' THEN tot END) AS kam FROM r WHERE rn=1) SELECT ROUND(sme-lam,2), ROUND(lam-kam,2), ROUND(kam-sme,2) FROM m

SELECT ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption END)) / SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption END), 4) FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date='2012-08-25' AND Price=634.8)

SELECT CAST((julianday(MAX(t.Date||' '||t.Time)) - julianday(MIN(t.Date||' '||t.Time))) * 1440 + 0.5 AS INTEGER) FROM transactions_1k t JOIN gasstations g ON g.GasStationID=t.GasStationID WHERE g.Country='CZE' AND t.Price>1000
